sections.name: Don Bongo
sections.card:
Summary: The boss waiting at the end of the level Frustration. He stomps from one side of the room to the other, and pots and pans drop from above while he does.
Weak points: Three hits on his lips with eggs beat him. An egg that lands anywhere else on him just bounces off.
Looks like: A chubby creature like a dragon, green and spotted with yellow, with thick red lips and a striped yellow stomach.
Tips: Bumping into him is harmless, since you simply bounce away. What drops from the ceiling is the only danger.
Tips: His lips puff up after every hit, making them somewhat easier to aim at, but after the second hit he speeds up a lot.

sections.name: Cloudjin
sections.card:
Summary: A genie made of smoke that you face once the level Poochy & Nippy has its 30 fruits eaten. He sends spiked balls rolling down slippery see-saws and breathes fire.
Weak points: Three eggs thrown at his stomach beat him, and only while he is tangible.
Looks like: A giant genie made of smoke that floats about.
Tips: He flashes red when an egg hurts him, but only in the Japanese release; the international releases do not show it.

sections.name: Inviso
sections.card:
Summary: A ghost boss met last in The Tall Tower. He turns invisible and tries to run into Yoshi while summoning Peepers.
Weak points: It takes three egg hits to beat him.
Looks like: He is invisible; the only thing that shows is the world reflected on him.
Tips: An egg that strips a Peeper of its feathers makes it fall, and eating it at that point heals Yoshi fully.

sections.name: Cloud N. Candy
sections.card:
Summary: The boss at the end of the level Cloud Cruising, a smiling cloud made of cotton candy.
Weak points: You beat her by licking her. Each lick takes a piece off her, so she shrinks, and she is beaten once all of her has been eaten.
Looks like: An enormous, floating cloud with a smile, fluffy and yellow, made of cotton candy.
Tips: She jumps around while you fight and hurts you if you touch her. Shrinking her makes her faster and nimbler. Each lick heals you a little.

sections.name: Bone Dragon
sections.card:
Summary: Hydra-like skeleton dragons that usually bar your way in the level Bone Dragon Pit and sometimes spit a fireball.
Weak points: Two hits to the head, from eggs or from a ground pound, get you past one. On a three-headed one, each head takes two hits of its own.
Looks like: A large dragon skeleton that looks like a hydra. A three-headed version, with a body as well, also exists.
Tips: Touching the body of a three-headed one does not hurt you. Beating a Bone Dragon earns three melons.

sections.name: Snorkel Snake
sections.card:
Summary: A serpentine enemy in just one area of Lots O'Jelly Fish, a level, that circles around a Yoshi it spots swimming nearby. It counts as a mini-boss, yet it cannot be defeated.
Looks like: A big, white, green-spiked creature whose tail is one large fin. Its head is a round ball with red eyes and flippers, and a spout where a mouth would be.
Tips: Eggs cannot be thrown while you are underwater, which makes it as good as invincible. What you have to do is defeat the Cheep Cheeps inside its lair while avoiding it.
Tips: Its body is too short to close a full circle, so a Yoshi it has ringed can still swim out.

sections.name: Heart Fruit and Super Happy
sections.card:
Summary: A fruit that turns the Yoshi who eats it Super Happy, but only for a limited time. Some are found in bubbles, and one drifts down from the sky when you eat six matching fruits back to back.
Uses: Super Happy makes a Yoshi invincible and stronger, gives unlimited eggs, a longer tongue and a better flutter jump, and fills the Smile Meter completely. Ground-pounding in this form bursts every bubble on the screen, and peppers become coins while Shy Guys become Lucky Fruit.
Tips: The form wears off at once if you eat anything such as a pepper, a blue Tehee Butterfly or a Black Shy Guy, or if a Piranha Pest eats you. Entering a new area that turns the page also ends it.
Tips: Even Super Happy invincibility cannot save you from fatal hazards like pits, lava, pistons and Blurps.

sections.name: Special Hearts
sections.card:
Summary: Three Special Hearts are hidden in every level, and each one you pick up unlocks a level on the following page.
Uses: From the second page onward, the following page lets you in only to its opening level, unless you collected a Special Heart in the level you just played. Collecting all three is what unlocks every level of the following page. Picking one up also restores a Yoshi's health completely.
Tips: You hear chimes as a Baby Yoshi gets near one. Throwing an egg at one also collects it.
Tips: Each Special Heart is worth 100 hearts. Collecting them also boosts Yoshi's Mood when the stage ends.

sections.name: Power Flower
sections.card:
Summary: A special sunflower that grows out of the ground. A Baby Yoshi can eat its head to recover.
Uses: The head restores two petals on the Smile Meter. Unlike fruit and Shy Guys it scores no points, so it does not raise Yoshi's Mood once the stage is finished.
Looks like: A sunflower with a green stem and leaves. Its head is yellow, with a small red mouth, black eyes and red petals.
Tips: After you eat a head, a new one soon grows back, so you can go on eating from the same flower until you have all your health again.

sections.name: Bomb Berry
sections.card:
Summary: A spiky fruit found only in the level Jungle Puddle. Most Yoshis find the taste awful.
Uses: Contact with one costs the Yoshi some petals of the Smile Meter. Eating one also costs petals, though the Black and White Yoshis are spared.
Looks like: Shaped like an eggplant, in yellow and red, and covered in green spikes.
Tips: Bomb Berries stay invisible until you walk past. Each one then swells, falls into the water once it is too heavy, and sinks; after a while another sprouts at the same spot.

sections.name: Pak E. Derm
sections.card:
Summary: An elephant-like creature that bars the way with a stop sign. Three of them stand in the level Treasure Hunt, and nowhere else.
Tips: Ground-pound the floor and it tips onto its head, letting you through. Move fast: it soon gets back on its feet.
Tips: It stands on whichever path you have chosen, and shifts across to the other one if you change paths.

sections.name: Tehee Butterfly
sections.card:
Summary: A flying butterfly that keeps changing colour between pink and blue. What happens when you eat it depends on its colour at that moment.
Looks like: A round flying insect that changes colour from pink to blue.
Tips: A pink one restores health when eaten, while a blue one tastes bitter and drains it. Eating a blue one while Super Happy cuts that form short.
Tips: When you bounce off one as a springboard, the wiki calls it a Tehee Trampoline.

sections.name: Black Shy Guy (Yoshi's Story)
sections.card:
Summary: An aggressive kind of Flying Shy Guy, first met in the level Poochy & Nippy.
Tips: On Page 6 they float in place holding weights meant to drop on anyone passing underneath, and a ground pound close to one makes it let go straight away. In Poochy & Nippy they swoop in from above the screen and drop bombs on you; those bombs break rock blocks, which you can use.
Tips: Unlike an ordinary Flying Shy Guy, a ground pound near one has no effect on it. Eating one yields a black-spotted egg, but most Yoshis show disgust and lose three Smile Meter petals, and the Super Happy form ends. Black and White Yoshis appear able to stomach it and gain two petals.

sections.name: Air Bag
sections.card:
Summary: A giant pink balloon that waits inside a Mystery Crate. You find them only in the back half of Surprise!!, a level on Page 1.
Weak points: Hit the bandages stuck on its belly twice, with eggs or with Huffin Puffin's chicks. When it goes down it deflates and vanishes, leaving a melon.
Looks like: A huge pink balloon with two bandages on its belly.
Tips: You can neither shove the crate nor smash it with a ground pound. Firing an egg or a chick at the crate reveals the Air Bag inside.
Tips: It attacks by blowing a powerful blast of wind at you. That does no damage, but it may knock you into other enemies.

sections.name: Blindfold Boo
sections.card:
Summary: A blindfolded Boo that homes in on sounds, since it cannot see. Four of them haunt the Ghost Castle and nowhere else, three early on and one during the tower climb.
Looks like: In this game it has a light-blue blindfold, not a black one, and fake pink ears instead of arms.
Tips: Attacks do nothing to it, and while it chases you it can outrun a Yoshi. Touching it, or being hit by any attack of its, costs three Smile Meter petals.
